categories.name: docs
categories.evidence: Only modifies doc/i2p.md to document -privatebroadcast behavior with I2P destinations.
categories.rationale: Clarifies an inaccuracy in I2P documentation regarding address persistence. As the author notes, 'doc/i2p.md stated that persistent I2P addresses are used for making outbound connections and accepting incoming ones' without explaining that `-privatebroadcast` forces a transient destination per transaction.
